abstention_rules: At least two supported findings must be assessed
Confirmed-observation coverage must be at least 0.50
At least one independent evidence family must contribute
aggregation_rules: Average assessed assertion contributions inside each evidence family
Combine only independent evidence families using explicit positive weights
Exclude unknown source dependencies from the aggregate
coverage_rules: Only confirmed resolved observations count as supported
Unknown and unevaluable findings have no numeric contribution
out_of_scope_rules: Age below 18 years is outside this engineering profile
Missing or ambiguous age prevents adult-scope reasoning

score_scale.description: Deterministic family-normalized compatibility from explicit assertions; never a clinical probability
